**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no Vendor indemnity in the Agreement.**

What I found:
- Section 7 is headed "LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; **INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR**", but the section body contains only a liability cap (7(a)), a consequential damages waiver (7(b)), and an attorneys' fee waiver (7(c)). A document-wide search for "indemnif" / "hold harmless" hits nothing but that heading — so there is no operative indemnity in either direction.
- Section 5(c) provides only a non-infringement warranty. That is not a defence obligation, and any recovery on it is squeezed by the Section 7(a) cap (fees paid) and the Section 7(c) fee waiver — leaving us exposed to third-party IP claims arising from RadialSpark's Works.
- This sits at the playbook walk-away position (no Vendor IP indemnity at all). Nothing to narrow on our side, since no Customer indemnity exists.

Redline (validated, ok:true) — new Section 7(d) inserted after p0037:
- RadialSpark defends and indemnifies Clear Capital and affiliates for third-party claims alleging the Services/Works infringe or misappropriate IP, RadialSpark's breach of law, RadialSpark-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of our Confidential Information/data, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
- Standard procedure: prompt notice, Vendor control of defence/settlement (no settlement imposing obligations or admissions on us without consent), our reasonable cooperation at Vendor's expense.
- Carve-out from the Section 7(a) cap and Section 7(c) fee waiver, so the indemnity is not rendered illusory.

Fallback flagged in the comment if resisted: usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications) plus procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, with the indemnity subject to a 3× annual fees super-cap.
